title.zh: dsh-sm — 安全守则与项目记忆

description.zh: 在每个 DSH 会话中注入可编辑的安全守则与项目记忆工作流；自动读取 MEMO.md、引导新项目建立记忆文件，把关键上下文落到磁盘。
description.en: Injects live-editable safety rules and a project-memory workflow into every DSH conversation; auto-reads MEMO.md, bootstraps new projects, and keeps context on disk.
